name: Crack a fetch on turn 1-2 for a land that unlocks a hand card
intent: On turn 1 or 2, once open-land-unlocks has had first refusal, play a fetch from hand and crack it for whatever land in the library would unlock some other hand card - Arid Mesa found for a library Mountain that lets Ragavan be cast. The fetch itself is chosen among whichever hand fetches can already reach an unlock (select's own unlocks_by_search: true already narrows to exactly that, regardless of prefer order - the prefer tiers below only break a genuine tie between two or more such fetches). Prefers a fetch that searches for Swamp (Marsh Flats) then one that searches for Island (Flooded Strand) ahead of Arid Mesa specifically: Arid Mesa's own Mountain-or-Plains search always overlaps every other fetch's own Plains half, so a review found it winning prefer by simply being listed Mountain-first even in a hand where the actual unlock needed nothing red at all - Arid Mesa is picked only when it is the only fetch select admits (see the invariant test below), never by default. searches_for_any reads the fetch's own template rather than the printed 'Search your library for' phrase, since that phrase also matches Urza's Saga elsewhere in the format and searches_for_any is what actually narrows to a basic land type. Its own choose_cards pick prefers a basic first (never spend life when a free basic unlocks the same thing), then a shockland, paying life only when the fetch's own find needs it. The source cracked is always the one whose own search can reach the unlock (unlocks_by_search: true, in select rather than merely preferred - this play only fires when some hand-or-library path unlocks something, so its own crack source is never legitimately one that cannot reach it; the DSL has no 'played this turn' condition to prefer instead, but unlocks_by_search is strictly the correct criterion regardless of when a battlefield fetch was played). Stands down once open-land-unlocks would already fire (U's own key), at 7 life or less, and once the library is down to 5 cards or fewer - thinning this early is not worth decking risk later. Only turns 1-2, land drop available, mine, precombat main, empty stack.
